news.title: Bitcoin has soared 50% on average after midterms. The S&P 500 has gained 15%.
news.summary: Both bitcoin and the S&P 500 have historically produced positive returns in a year after midterms. BTC's pattern, however, could also be explained by the four-year halving cycles.

news.title: Moody’s assigns investment-grade ratings to Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin
news.summary: Moody's Ratings assigned the RLUSD A2 long-term and P-1 short-term ratings, citing credit quality and market value of its reserve assets.

news.title: Securitize adds Stellar blockchain as institutional tokenization gathers steam
news.summary: The firms announced the agreement at Meridian 2026, the Stellar Development Foundation’s annual conference in Portugal.

news.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows climb to $176M as BTC rebounds above $80K
news.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $286 million over two days, narrowing October’s net outflows to $26 million as the Crypto Fear & Greed Index remained neutral.

news.title: Coinbase denies systems breach, says vendor exposed customer data
news.summary: Coinbase said that an incident at analytics vendor Amplitude exposed some customers’ contact data, but it found no evidence of unauthorized access to its own systems.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Bitcoin treasury Datavault AI plunges 50% after firm says it can’t access its BTC
news.summary: The company said the accounting correction will cut reported assets by $92.2 million at the end of 2025 after bitcoin held on Biconomy could not be withdrawn.

news.title: Bithumb hacked through employee system as South Korean financial firms face cyberattacks
news.summary: The breach hit an internal employee system that Bithumb says is separate from its trading platform, while the exchange is still determining whether customer information was exposed.

news.title: Bitcoin nears $81,000 ahead of Fed decision as ZEC jumps 8%
news.summary: Majors outpaced bitcoin across the board as tech stocks extended a climb.

news.title: Robinhood’s Tenev warns US tokenization uncertainty deters ‘serious assets’
news.summary: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev says tokenized equities need more than a temporary SEC exemption to flourish in the US.

news.title: Coinbase says user funds are safe after third-party vendor exposes customer contact info
news.summary: The crypto exchange says an incident at analytics firm Amplitude exposed some customer contact information, but insists its own systems were not breached.

news.title: Datavault AI stock plummets 50% after firm says it cannot withdraw bitcoin tied to $150 million deal
news.summary: The issue centers on a deal with Scilex, under which Scilex agreed to buy shares of Datavault AI for $150 million, payable in bitcoin.

news.title: Bithumb discloses data leak after internal system breach: Report
news.summary: The breach impacted its in-house mobile system, used by employees for work and information sharing.

news.title: Discord is making public chats searchable on Google: How to opt out
news.summary: Discord conversations on large public servers will soon reach audiences far beyond their communities, raising privacy concerns.

news.title: VanEck launches diversified ETF combining stocks, bonds and Bitcoin exposure
news.summary: VanEck’s new Wealth Builder ETF targets a 2% Bitcoin allocation, with a permitted range of 1% to 5%, gaining exposure through a spot Bitcoin ETP.

news.title: Intel, IBM, Oracle and IonQ latest to object to OKX-ICE tokenized stocks
news.summary: More than 40% of the companies initially proposed to have their stocks listed in tokenized form have asked to opt-out.

news.title: Robinhood Chain brings in $26 million as crypto revenue rises 20% in Q3
news.summary: Robinhood’s blockchain boosted crypto revenue, while prediction markets brought in $173 million in the third quarter.

news.title: Treasury's Bessent sees crypto as America's next tool for keeping the U.S. dollar on top
news.summary: Speaking at Ripple's conference, the U.S. Treasury Secretary said the SEC and CFTC action could help fill the gap left by the Clarity Act's failure, while curbing crypto debanking.

news.title: Quantum fears already limiting Bitcoin’s growth, Stacks founder says
news.summary: Speaking on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction podcast, Muneeb Ali warned that uncertainty over Bitcoin’s quantum security could deter institutional investors.

news.title: Robinhood's crypto revenue fell 55% from last year, but topped Street forecasts
news.summary: Crypto trading volume fell 38% from year-ago levels, but the firm's overall blockchain business gained traction.

news.title: Ripple, Robinhood expand partnership to bring RLUSD to retail and institutional markets
news.summary: Ripple also expanded its collaboration with BNY on digital asset custody and partnered with C2FO to bring trade finance settlement onto the XRP Ledger.

news.title: CFTC sues Utah to block action against prediction markets
news.summary: The US state filed a lawsuit against Kalshi last week, seeking to recover up to $60 million in profits related to event contracts on prediction markets.

news.title: U.S. agency hits Utah with lawsuit to shield Kalshi's ability to offer betting there
news.summary: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission has pursued more than a dozen legal actions to protect what its chief sees as its sole power over prediction markets.

news.title: CFTC sues Utah as battle over prediction market regulation intensifies
news.summary: The CFTC is escalating its legal fight with states, suing Utah after the state filed a lawsuit against prediction market platform Kalshi.

news.title: Intel, Oracle, IBM join growing list of firms objecting to OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
news.summary: The latest notice added four objections, bringing the total to 26 as the joint venture prepares to test the SEC’s new framework for blockchain-based stock trading.

news.title: Majority of Americans want candidates who support US-based financial technology: Poll
news.summary: The September survey offered a possible window into US voters who could consider fintech and digital asset policies on Election Day.

news.title: Crypto.com and OG.com launch US crypto perps with up to 5x leverage
news.summary: The contracts have no expiration date and allow traders to bet on crypto prices rising or falling.

news.title: Brazilian companies turned to stablecoins on election day to dodge a currency crash
news.summary: USDT volume on crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin jumped nearly 800% and bitcoin volume surged 865%. Binance’s USDT/BRL market tripled while the global BTC/USDT pair fell.

news.title: Canton-based trading platform Cancore raises $7.2 million at $60 million token valuation

news.title: Janus Henderson, Centrifuge launch tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar
news.summary: The blockchain-based fund offers eligible non-US investors exposure to the Nasdaq-100 as Janus Henderson expands its institutional tokenization business.

news.title: Robinhood taps Ripple’s $2.5 billion RLUSD stablecoin despite backing rival USDG
news.summary: Robinhood helped launch a rival dollar-backed token, USDG, but will also offer Ripple's stablecoin to retail customers later this year.

news.title: USDC overtakes USDT in euro stablecoin trading as EU rules reshape market: Kaiko
news.summary: USDC’s share of euro stablecoin trading has climbed to 56% since January 2024, with deeper liquidity as exchanges restrict USDT under MiCA.

news.title: SoFi discloses 503,000 crypto products as gross crypto revenue hits $162 million
news.summary: SoFi broke out crypto products for the first time. Gross crypto revenue rose 20%, while total net revenue hit a record $1.39 billion.

news.title: Ripple, BNY explore using the XRP Ledger to finance approved invoices
news.summary: BNY adds XRP and RLUSD to its custody platform, as Ripple and C2FO test settling invoice payments on the XRP Ledger.

news.title: Galaxy Digital swings to $323 million quarterly profit, announces new $200 million share buyback
news.summary: Galaxy returned to profitability in the third quarter as trading volumes and lending increased, with a new $200 million buyback authorized.

news.title: Bitcoin mining infrastructure firm Luxor raises $16 million to expand AI business
news.summary: The company plans to expand its AI business and hire about 12 people by year-end, COO Ethan Vera told The Block.

news.title: Nasdaq-100 comes onchain as Janus Henderson and Centrifuge launch first licensed fund
news.summary: The $500 billion asset manager is launching an issuer-sponsored fund on Stellar, taking a different approach from third-party stock tokens.

news.title: Crypto Market Structure Explained
news.summary: Crypto market structure is the architecture behind digital asset markets. It explains who participates, where trades happen, how liquidity forms, how prices are discovered, how derivatives and funding rates work, and how market design affects execution, fairness, risk, and resilience.

news.title: CF Benchmarks brings Wall Street pricing infrastructure onchain, including data used by BlackRock
news.summary: The new service could help developers build blockchain-based index funds, tokenized portfolios and derivatives using established financial benchmarks.

news.title: Crypto could outperform AI stocks: Wall Street veteran Jordi Visser
news.summary: Former Morgan Stanley and Weiss executive Jordi Visser says AI agents are boosting demand for crypto as he expands his holdings beyond Bitcoin, Ether and Solana.

news.title: Bitcoin miners' move into AI is creating a new market for trading computing power
news.summary: Luxor raised $16 million to expand into AI hardware and trading, betting that computing power will become a market where companies can hedge costs and prices.

news.title: Hayes details FLOP’s AI compute derivatives vision after selling his altcoins
news.summary: Arthur Hayes revealed the derivatives market design for Flop Network and how he expects its native token could transform AI compute into a tradable commodity.

news.title: Luxor raises $16M from CMT Digital amid AI-Bitcoin miner convergence
news.summary: Luxor aims to use the proceeds to scale its existing AI infrastructure business and expand its GPU sourcing services as global chip supply chains become constrained.

news.title: Bitcoin price analysis sees ‘strong rally’ as old coins become dormant
news.summary: A decline in the share of Bitcoin’s realized cap held by coins unmoved for 18 months or longer points to the ‘early stages’ of a bull market, analysis says.

news.title: Zcash co-founder proposes ending grants subsidy, citing $125 million treasury
news.summary: Zcash co-founder Sean Bowe proposed ending automatic grants funding, citing a treasury valuation of more than $125 million.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin edges higher as Nasdaq surges 1.2%
news.summary: The Fed is expected to hold rates steady on Wednesday, but markets will be looking for clues about future policy moves.

news.title: Japan's top yen stablecoin falls short of its target in a disappointing first year
news.summary: CEO Noritaka Okabe blamed a 1 million yen per-transaction cap for Type II funds transfer providers, which has slowed corporate adoption.

news.title: Bitcoin drops below $80,000 as crypto ignores Asian tech rally, Fed meeting begins
news.summary: Bitcoin fell 0.4% to around $79,700 since midnight UTC while Asian tech stocks rallied. The DeFi index dropped 1.8%, and the Fed is set to begin a two-day meeting.

news.title: Crypto wallet maker Keystone to destroy almost 19,000 devices after security breach
news.summary: The breach exposed 25,964 buyer records, some kept past Keystone’s 180-day deletion policy after an automated tool failed without the firm noticing.

news.title: Investor who called for AI pivot in 2023 says bitcoin is going to $57,000
news.summary: Jason Calacanis wants investors to sell bitcoin and back artificial intelligence. He is also holding TAO, the cryptocurrency behind AI network Bittensor.

news.title: Ark Invest buys $5.2 million of Circle shares, sells $15.9 million of its own Bitcoin ETF as BTC grinds lower
news.summary: Ark Invest rebalanced its fund weightings, adding Circle shares and trimming its Bitcoin ETF holdings as BTC fell below $80,000.

news.title: Zcash co-founder calls to stop funding ‘over $125M’ grants program
news.summary: Sean Bowe says ZCG has enough money to keep funding projects and wants its share of new ZEC redirected to a reserve for the network.

news.title: Now is the time to accumulate bitcoin, Galaxy says
news.summary: Galaxy argues improving price trends, resilient ETF demand and rising U.S. debt support bitcoin’s recovery towards its previous high.

news.title: Bloom bot hackers loot $953K faster than you can microwave popcorn
news.summary: Bloom pledged to reimburse nine traders after $953,000 was drained from 48 wallets, saying no private keys were accessed or compromised.

news.title: An AI label alone no longer wins lenders, JPMorgan says
news.summary: As default insurance on several AI-linked firms hits record costs, companies must show they can finance investment, service the debt and eventually mint cash, JPMorgan says.

news.title: Binance files for Brazil crypto license ahead of Friday deadline
news.summary: The exchange is delisting 22 crypto assets for Brazilian users and hopes talks with the central bank will allow it to restore some services.

news.title: Solana bug reports now cost 1 SOL as AI floods security teams with spam
news.summary: Researchers must now permanently burn 1 SOL for every submission after a monthlong contest drew 809 reports, with AI believed to have helped generate or write nearly all of them.

news.title: Bitcoin ETFs claw back $110M after $774M exit
news.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs remained in the red for October, with about $202 million in net outflows for the month despite Monday’s rebound.

news.title: Ethereum fixes Glamsterdam bug that could have sent staking deposits to builders
news.summary: Developers initially rejected the change before reversing course, as testing delays gave them more time to examine a flaw in Ethereum's upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade.

news.title: Circle faces up to 20% revenue risk from AI agents, Mizuho says
news.summary: Mizuho cited 10-20% medium-term reserve revenue downside risk as AI agents steer USDC holders toward higher-yielding fiat alternatives.

news.title: RedotPay weighs confidential US IPO filing by year-end: Bloomberg
news.summary: The stablecoin payments company previously disputed reports that its US listing had been delayed.

news.title: StoneX lifts Strive price target 34% as new stock offering bolsters bitcoin strategy
news.summary: StoneX has raised its price target for bitcoin treasury company Strive to $43 from $32 and reiterated its Buy rating on the stock.

news.title: Ripple gains final OCC approval to launch national trust bank and bring RLUSD under federal oversight
news.summary: Ripple's structure places reserve management and custody under federal supervision while leaving issuance with the New York-regulated entity.

news.title: Keystone breach deepens: Hackers stole key used to verify wallets as genuine
news.summary: Keystone initially disclosed a leak of customer information but has since disclosed that hackers also stole a key that could allow counterfeit wallets to pass authenticity checks.

news.title: BlackRock joins SBI and Startale to link tokenized MMFs with Japanese yen stablecoins
news.summary: BlackRock, SBI Holdings, and Startale will explore connecting tokenized money market funds with SBI's Japanese yen-pegged stablecoin JPYSC.

news.title: Ripple wins final US approval for national trust bank
news.summary: The approval clears the way for Ripple to manage reserves backing its RLUSD stablecoin and provide digital asset custody.

news.title: CZ pitches BNB Chain’s role in AI as BNB Standard rings Nasdaq bell
news.summary: CZ sees AI driving crypto use, while BNB Standard plans to expand beyond holding tokens in its treasury.

news.title: Hyperliquid says Kraken parent Payward to be first CFTC-regulated HIP-3 deployer
news.summary: Hyperliquid plans to make Kraken parent Payward the first CFTC-regulated HIP-3 deployer, a step toward regulated U.S. perpetual futures.

news.title: Y Combinator-backed Mochatrade raises $5.5 million to offer US stock perpetuals to Indian traders
news.summary: The platform is in beta and plans to open to the public in the coming weeks, co-founder Chetan Manda told The Block.
